entities.name: Church of Saint-Pierre d'Aulnay
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of Saint-Pierre d'Aulnay is an important medieval church on the way to Saint-Jacques de Compostelle, in Aulnay, Charente-Maritime. The Church is thought to have been built in 1120–1140.
